slots.name: TikToks analyzed
slots.sentence: A Wall Street Journal analysis of more than four million TikToks posted between Aug. 1 and Sept. 20 sees a growing antipathy to the AI build-out with a dislike of data centers and AI uniting creators and creeping into areas of the social platform that rarely touch politics.
